# Sanjay Verma

> Personal portfolio of Sanjay Verma, Software Engineer II at Oxyzo Financial Services, specializing in backend systems and fintech infrastructure. NIT Kurukshetra CS graduate, open to new opportunities.

Single-page React application covering background, work experience, technical skills, projects, and contact details. All content lives on one page at the URLs below via section anchors.

## Sections

- [About](https://sanjay-verma.in/#about): Background and education
- [Experience](https://sanjay-verma.in/#experience): Work history at Oxyzo Financial Services
- [Skills](https://sanjay-verma.in/#skills): Technical skills and competencies
- [Projects](https://sanjay-verma.in/#projects): Selected engineering projects
- [Contact](https://sanjay-verma.in/#contact): Contact form and email
